stories.title: Suspensions, picks revoked and a $30 million fine: Making sense of the NBA's staggering Clippers punishment
stories.summary: A $30M fine. Five first-round picks taken away. Steve Ballmer suspended for a year. ESPN's NBA insiders break down the harshest punishment in league history.

stories.title: Clippers docked 5 first-round picks, fined $30M
stories.summary: Following an investigation into a Kawhi Leonard sponsorship, the NBA docked the Clippers five first-round picks, fined them $30 million and suspended owner Steve Ballmer for a year. The Clippers plan to challenge the findings "through every avenue."

stories.title: Roberts says Ohtani 'visibly' ailing, weighs day off
stories.summary: Dodgers manager Dave Roberts said Shohei Ohtani is "not close to optimal" after going 0-for-4 with four strikeouts in Wednesday night's 8-6 loss to the Cardinals.

stories.title: Georgia AG to SEC: Oust LSU if Kiffin plays pros
stories.summary: Georgia Attorney General Chris Carr is encouraging Greg Sankey to take "all measures available," including suspending and/or removing LSU from the SEC if the Tigers roster former NFL players.

stories.title: Report: CEO, president exit Good Good after ad
stories.summary: The fallout from last month's controversial Good Good Golf ad continued Wednesday, with CEO Matt Kendrick and president Joe Flannery exiting the company, Business Insider reported.
